in_marathi.name: Mahek
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mahek हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘māheṣā’, meaning ‘great lord’. The name Mahek signifies power, strength, and courage. In Hindu mythology, it is believed that the name is associated with the goddess Durga, symbolizing her fierce and mighty nature.
